g.text: 1. Section on the plane x = 0 (the y axis through the centre).
No single vertical line crosses every layer: the battery ends at
y = -10.2, the ledge and tape lie outside r = 11.0.
2. Rev D stack: FR-4 base plate 0.80 / adhesive sheet 0.20 /
PCB 0.80 (underside at z 1.0). The posts hold the PCB
top at z = 1.8; the perimeter seal joint (base top to
the seal face at z 1.2) is 0.4 mm high. Alternative
3. z values are heights above the base plane.
5. On x = 0 the roof is the thick roof (2.05, underside
z 5.55) or the nose pad; the plain 0.8 roof
6. The tub wall ends at z = 0.25 (rim relief): base
plate and ball feet are the lowest surfaces.
7. Grain opening: clear potting from the PCB down to z 0.05
at most (shown); accepted z 0.05 to 0.15. The crest of the
baffle ring GL1-013 is never covered by the potting.
8. OPTIONAL (E9, EVT trial): quarter-wave film Ø23.4 x 0.1
on the glass underside, inside the Ø25.0 bore of the tape
ring; 0.03 above the roof ledge outside the aperture,
0.98 above the LCD. Clocking flat 4.3 long toward
